## Discussion (1)

### rodaddy — 2026-08-10T13:52:52Z

## Closed — the direction taken and why

**What was built.** `scripts/sync-issues.ts` now renders a `## Resolution`
section into every CLOSED issue's artifact, carrying the closing PR number, its
merge SHA, its merged-at timestamp, and its body reproduced byte-for-byte. An
`aqmd` search that finds a resolved question now returns the answer instead of a
`State: CLOSED` stamp. 267 of 267 closed issues render one as of this sweep.

**Why this design, over the alternatives considered.**

- *Resolution comes from the TIMELINE, not `closedByPullRequestsReferences`.*
  That field is the obvious one and it is EMPTY in this repo: lanes squash-merge
  into a wip branch, so GitHub's auto-close linkage never registers. Measured on
  #681 — closed demonstrably by PR #687, field returns `[]`. Building on it would
  have asserted absence on precisely the issues that DO have a resolution.
  Three measured closure shapes are handled instead: PR closer (20 of 25 recent),
  commit closer correlated by merge SHA (2), and no PR at all (3).
- *Cross-referenced PRs are never rendered as a candidate list.* #659 is
  cross-referenced by four PRs and closed by one. They resolve a closing commit
  SHA to its PR and nothing else — an ambiguous answer fails the operator ruling
  as surely as a missing one.
- *The PR body is blockquoted, not inlined.* PR bodies carry their own `##`
  headings; inlined raw they became top-level sections of the ISSUE, so the PR's
  structure masqueraded as the artifact's. Blockquoting keeps every line inside
  its section and byte-identical.
- *A delta on the existing generator, not a parallel artifact system.* One
  generated file per issue, the GENERATED header, and overwrite-on-sync semantics
  are unchanged.
- *Closed-without-a-PR renders honestly.* It names the close actor and state
  reason and names no PR, rather than staying silent or speculating. Visible live
  on #712's own artifact.

**The process half.** The generator can only preserve what was written, so
controller-contract obligation 2b (lane-contract round 27) now requires a closure
comment on the ISSUE at merge stating direction, why, and receipts. This comment
is that obligation applied to its own issue.

**The gate saga, one sentence.** Four prior landing attempts failed on gates
rather than on the work — `_githooks/pre-push` aborted every push with
`WriteFailed` on a green 3372-pass suite whenever git piped bun's stderr (#712),
and `pr-body-gate` resolved the Done-means script from the primary checkout
instead of the PR's own tree (#706/#709) — all three are now merged and were
live-proven by this very landing: the push printed `pre-push: all checks passed`
and the validator announced `Done-means resolved in the tree under review`.
